en: Black‑and‑white view of a large European manor or small palace with a corner tower and steep tiled roof, seen from an elevated angle over dense trees in the foreground. The building has several floors of tall rectangular windows and dormer windows in the roof. In the background, there is another long wing of the complex and a distant church or chapel tower with an onion‑shaped dome, typical of Central European Baroque architecture. No visible caption or border text appears on the image.
